verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a WebSDK (with a React package) and Web and Mobile SDKs, including an iOS SDK theme API, so the SDK half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the evidence describes guided camera capture, or glare, blur, or edge detection coaching. Customizable step instructions and tips are a branding feature, not capture-quality feedback. Missing for 10: any evidence of real-time glare, blur, or edge detection during capture, an explicitly documented native Android SDK, guided document capture documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try
